evaluation_purpose: Demonstrate review-prioritization under operational human review budgets (20% review capacity).
scientific_conclusion: Confidence-based review prioritization performs substantially better than random review on all evaluated datasets. Our custom classifier performs comparably to native Whisper confidence, but its additional benefit remains uncertain.

cohorts.name: Common Voice 17 Development Verification
cohorts.limitation: Development evidence. Repeatedly explored and tuned on during model iteration; not independent final validation.

cohorts.name: LibriSpeech Live Holdout
cohorts.limitation: External clean audiobook holdout. Contains only 22 high-error clips; low statistical power where 1 clip shifts recall by 4.55%.

cohorts.name: AMI Meeting Corpus Holdout 1
cohorts.limitation: Conversational multi-speaker holdout. All 750 clips derive from only 4 linked meeting groups and 16 speakers.

cohorts.name: AMI Meeting Corpus Holdout 2 (Audio-Aware)
cohorts.limitation: Acoustic feature controlled experiment across 16 meeting families. Paired differences between native and acoustic hybrid remain within cluster variation.

methodological_safeguards: Human reference transcripts and WER values were strictly isolated for evaluation labels and never exposed to inference models.
Identical eligible clip populations evaluated across all ranking methods within each cohort.
Scores oriented consistently: higher risk = higher priority, lower logprob = higher priority.
Missing confidence handled deterministically: missing confidence ranked first.
